english: to persist; to persevere; to keep up
example_cn: 只要坚持下去，就一定会成功。
example_pinyin: Zhǐyào jiānchí xiàqù, jiù yídìng huì chénggōng.
example_en: As long as you persist, you will definitely succeed.

english: to cheer on; make an extra effort; keep it up!
example_cn: 明天的考试一定要加油！
example_pinyin: Míngtiān de kǎoshì yídìng yào jiāyóu!
example_en: Good luck on tomorrow's exam, keep it up!

example_cn: 生活永远充满希望。
example_pinyin: Shēnghuó yǒngyuǎn chōngmǎn xīwàng.
example_en: Life is always full of hope.

example_cn: 永远不要放弃你的梦想。
example_pinyin: Yǒngyuǎn bú yào fàngqì nǐ de mèngxiǎng.
example_en: Never give up on your dreams.

example_cn: 学习是一生的旅程。
example_pinyin: Xuéxí shì yìshēng de lǚchéng.
example_en: Learning is a lifelong journey.

example_cn: 珍惜当下的简单就是幸福。
example_pinyin: Zhēnxī dāngxià de jiǎndān jiù shì xìngfú.
example_en: Cherishing simplicity in the present moment is true happiness.

english: to cherish; to treasure; to value
example_cn: 我们要珍惜身边的每一个人。
example_pinyin: Wǒmen yào zhēnxī shēnbiān de měi yí gè rén.
example_en: We should cherish everyone around us.

example_cn: 经历风雨才能积累智慧。
example_pinyin: Jīnglì fēngyǔ cái néng jīlěi zhìhuì.
example_en: Only through trials can one accumulate wisdom.

example_cn: 面对困难，他依然从容不迫。
example_pinyin: Miànduì kùnnan, tā yīrán cóngróng búpò.
example_en: Facing difficulties, he remained calm and unhurried.

example_cn: 有朋自远方来，不亦乐乎？
example_pinyin: Yǒu péng zì yuǎnfāng lái, bú yì yuè hū?
example_en: Is it not delightful to have friends coming from distant places?

example_cn: 勇敢面对内心的恐惧。
example_pinyin: Yǒnggǎn miànduì nèixīn de kǒngjù.
example_en: Bravely face the fears inside your heart.

example_cn: 常怀感恩之心，生活才会更美好。
example_pinyin: Cháng huái gǎn'ēn zhī xīn, shēnghuó cái huì gèng měihǎo.
example_en: With a heart full of gratitude, life becomes even more wonderful.

example_cn: 思想的自由是无价的。
example_pinyin: Sīxiǎng de zìyóu shì wújià de.
example_en: Freedom of thought is priceless.

example_cn: 专注做好眼前的每一件事。
example_pinyin: Zhuānzhù zuò hǎo yǎnqián de měi yí jiàn shì.
example_en: Focus on doing each task in front of you well.

example_cn: 微笑是世界上通用的语言。
example_pinyin: Wēixiào shì shìjiè shàng tōngyòng de yǔyán.
example_en: A smile is the universal language of the world.

example_cn: 愿你的人生每一天都很精彩。
example_pinyin: Yuàn nǐ de rénshēng měi yì tiān dōu hěn jīngcǎi.
example_en: May every day of your life be wonderful and brilliant.

example_cn: 夜晚的海面十分平静。
example_pinyin: Yèwǎn de hǎimiàn shífēn píngjìng.
example_en: The sea surface at night is exceptionally calm.

example_cn: 对生活的热爱能照亮前行的路。
example_pinyin: Duì shēnghuó de rè'ài néng zhàoliàng qiánxíng de lù.
example_en: A passion for life can illuminate the road ahead.

example_cn: 人类对未知的探索从未停止。
example_pinyin: Rénlèi duì wèizhī de tànsuǒ cóngwèi tíngzhǐ.
example_en: Human exploration of the unknown has never ceased.

example_cn: 包容不同的观点能让人心胸宽广。
example_pinyin: Bāoróng bùtóng de guāndiǎn néng ràng rén xīnxiōng kuānguǎng.
example_en: Being open to different perspectives broadens the mind.

example_cn: 时间能沉淀最真实的感情。
example_pinyin: Shíjiān néng chéndiàn zuì zhēnshí de gǎnqíng.
example_en: Time settles and reveals the most genuine emotions.

example_cn: 冬日里的阳光格外温暖。
example_pinyin: Dōngrì lǐ de yángguāng géwài wēnnuǎn.
example_en: The sunshine on a winter day feels especially warm.

example_cn: 不忘初心，方得始终。
example_pinyin: Bú wàng chūxīn, fāng dé shǐzhōng.
example_en: Never forget why you started, and your mission can be accomplished.

example_cn: 自律给你带来真正的自由。
example_pinyin: Zìlǜ gěi nǐ dàilái zhēnzhèng de zìyóu.
example_en: Self-discipline brings you true freedom.

example_cn: 慢下来，从容地欣赏沿途风景。
example_pinyin: Màn xiàlái, cóngróng de xīnshǎng yántú fēngjǐng.
example_en: Slow down and leisurely enjoy the scenery along the way.

example_cn: 每一次挑战都是成长的机会。
example_pinyin: Měi yí cì tiǎozhàn dōu shì chéngzhǎng de jīhuì.
example_en: Every challenge is an opportunity for growth.

example_cn: 一份微小的善意也能温暖人心。
example_pinyin: Yí fèn wéixiǎo de shànyì yě néng wēnnuǎn rénxīn.
example_en: Even a tiny act of kindness can warm someone's heart.

example_cn: 她在逆境中表现得非常坚强。
example_pinyin: Tā zài nìjìng zhōng biǎoxiàn de fēicháng jiānqiáng.
example_en: She showed tremendous resilience in adversity.

example_cn: 相信自己，你就是自己的奇迹。
example_pinyin: Xiāngxìn zìjǐ, nǐ jiù shì zìjǐ de qíjì.
example_en: Believe in yourself; you are your own miracle.

example_cn: 会议圆满结束。
example_pinyin: Huìyì yuánmǎn jiéshù.
example_en: The conference concluded successfully and satisfactorily.
